network: Connection problem. Check your internet and try again.

auth.no_session: Your session expired. Sign in again.
auth.forbidden: You don't have access to do this.
auth.mfa_required: This money action needs two-step verification (MFA). Turn it on or sign in again.

not_eligible.own_org: You're a member of the brand that owns this campaign.
not_eligible.min_trust_score: Your Trust Score is too low.
not_eligible.min_followers: Your account doesn't have enough followers.
not_eligible.min_account_age: Your account is too new for this campaign.
not_eligible.max_clips: You've reached the clip limit for this campaign.

budget_exhausted: The campaign budget is used up.
already_claimed: You already claimed this campaign. Submit your video first.
invalid_state: This action isn't possible in the current status.
admin_account_must_be_separate: Admin accounts must be separate: this account is already registered as a clipper/brand. Invite a new email.
campaign_locked: The brief is locked since submission. Only the FAQ can change.
invoice_unpaid: The campaign invoice isn't paid yet.
pools_locked_after_payment: Budget can't change after payment. Use a top-up.
appeal_used: The appeal for this submission was already used.
appeal_closed: This campaign has ended, so appeals for this submission are closed.
invoice_campaign_closed: This campaign is no longer running, so the top-up/pin invoice can no longer be paid.
reward_stock_insufficient: Not enough reward stock for this pool. Add stock under Reward types or lower the pool amount.
appeal_replaced: You already submitted a replacement clip, so this clip can no longer be appealed.
invite_expired: This invite has expired. Ask for a new link.
reward_type_in_use: This reward type is used by a campaign.
config_key_locked: Only a super admin can change this setting.
below_minimum: Amount is below the minimum withdrawal.
trust_too_low: Your Trust Score is too low for instant withdrawal.
payout_blocked: Withdrawals are on hold for review. Contact support.
idempotency_conflict: Duplicate request detected. Reload the page.
pii_in_recipient: Contact/address data must be entered on the Account page.
recipient_ref_required: Complete your recipient details on the Account page.
amount_mismatch: Amount doesn't match the invoice total.
duplicate_payment_ref: This reference number was already used.
invoice_pool_mismatch: Invoice doesn't match the campaign budget.
batch_not_exported: Export the CSV before marking it paid.
payout_not_in_export: Withdrawal isn't in the transfer file.
code_assigned: The voucher code was already sent to the clipper.
claim_not_open: Your claim is no longer active. Claim the campaign again.
campaign_closed: The campaign no longer accepts submissions.
platform_not_allowed: This platform isn't accepted by the campaign.
posted_before_claim: The video was posted before you claimed the campaign.
duration_out_of_range: Video length is outside the brief's limits.
already_submitted: This video was already submitted to this campaign.
reused_video: This video is already used in another campaign.
social_taken: This account is already connected to another clipper.
ig_personal: Personal Instagram accounts aren't supported. Switch to a Creator account (free) and try again.
oauth_failed: Couldn't connect the account. Try again.
not_owner: This video doesn't belong to the connected account.
nik_taken: This NIK is already used by another account. Contact support.
invalid_nik: NIK must be a valid 16-digit number.
name_mismatch: The account holder name must match the name on your ID.
account_taken: This bank account is used by another account.
batch_locked: This payout is already in an approved batch. Mark it failed after export if needed.
delivery_in_flight: This reward is being delivered. Wait for the result (up to 5 minutes) before cancelling.
delivery_unconfirmed: A delivery attempt or export already happened. Confirm with the provider that the reward was not delivered, then tick the confirmation.
export_stale: The data changed since the export started. Export again.
file_missing: Export file not found. Export again.
last_owner: The organization needs at least one Owner. Make another member an Owner first.
faktur_used: This faktur number is already used by another invoice.
refund_name_mismatch: The account holder name must match the organization’s legal name.
refund_dest_missing: The brand hasn’t added a refund destination account.
refund_dest_invalid: The destination account is not valid (owner/KYC name/status). Ask the brand to update it.
org_unverified: You can add the refund account once the organization’s legal details are verified.
